stories.title: Bessent says all Iranian airlines will be shut down worldwide from September 23 under sweeping new sanctions
stories.reason: The Treasury secretary's secondary-sanctions threat targets every foreign fuel supplier, airport and ticketing agent that keeps servicing Iranian aircraft, with Turkey already saying it will bar Iranian planes -- a major escalation of economic pressure timed to Iran's president arriving in New York.

stories.title: Trump to meet Zelensky in New York as Ukraine pushes for a mutual halt on energy and Black Sea strikes
stories.reason: Zelensky arrived in the US with roughly 20 meetings planned on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, aiming to discuss a possible pause in strikes on energy infrastructure and finalize a new drone-cooperation deal with Washington.

stories.title: Iran's Revolutionary Guard warns it will 'change the geography of the war' if the US escalates
stories.reason: IRGC spokesman Hossein Mohebbi said Tehran is ready for a long war and would unveil weapons that will 'astound the world' if Trump orders fresh strikes, a defiant signal delivered as Bessent tightens sanctions and Iran's president heads to the UN.

stories.title: Saudi airstrikes on Yemen's Mokha kill six, including two children, as Houthis seize Red Sea coast
stories.reason: The strikes on a civilian residence came after rapid Houthi advances captured Mokha and other Red Sea positions from Saudi-backed government forces, underscoring how the Yemen front is intensifying in parallel with the wider Iran war.

stories.title: Trump says he's open to banning diesel exports as US prices top $6.50 a gallon
stories.reason: Bessent said officials are studying whether a full or partial export ban is feasible as farmers and truckers face record fuel costs driven by Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries, though Interior Secretary Burgum has warned the move could backfire on import-dependent regions.

stories.title: Wall Street closes at record highs as Nasdaq jumps 2.3% on a broad AI and tech rally
stories.reason: The Dow rose 0.7%, the S&P 500 gained 1.5% and the Nasdaq surged to a record close as falling oil prices and renewed Iran-diplomacy hopes fueled a rotation into tech and communications stocks, a day after AMD's market value crossed $1 trillion.

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV heads to France this week for the first papal visit in nearly 20 years
stories.reason: The four-day trip to Paris, Lourdes and Metz includes a private meeting with seven survivors of clergy sexual abuse and addresses to French, UN and European leaders, as the Church tries to rebuild trust after a damning 2021 report on decades of abuse.

stories.title: AI helps mathematicians crack a 25,000-case, decades-old inverse Galois problem
stories.reason: A collaboration blending professional and amateur mathematicians with AI-assisted search resolved nearly all cases of a symmetry-group problem tracing back to 19th-century mathematician Evariste Galois, another sign of AI accelerating fundamental research once thought decades from completion.
